name: sandbox
notes: Declared 2026-10-09 when the estate harness was added. Public repository, no releases, no other users, no money, no real user data: sandbox autonomy (law 9). The owner said in the founding session that commits, pushes, PRs, issues, merges, comments and reviews are free. Re-review the tier, and set sensitive_data, before the first of: a native file or process effect beyond read-only observation (any LW-* executor), real inventory or training data entering the repository or its fixtures, a published release or installer, or a connected model provider. Promotion to T2 is proposed in HUMAN_TODO.md. Codex (GPT-6.1 Sol) works here as a peer in its own worktree; the driver commits for it.
